race.comment: INCREMENTAL (2) copped early interference and didn't recover when fresh from a spell last start over 1300m at Newcastle. Placed in town last prep among a string of solid performances. Hard to beat if anywhere near his best form. NEAREST (3) showed little early pace but got going late to finish fourth when resuming over 1200m at this track last time out. Has only raced three times and is in good hands. Nicely placed over an extra 200m - should play a key role. RETRIEVER (10) showed pace but tired late to finish third on debut in a 1280m Muswellbrook maiden recently. Better for that hit-out and should offer a bit more today. Market watch on the Kris Lees-trained first starter MAMELA (9) who placed in a recent Gosford trial. REYLEGADO (5) didn't do much first-up at Muswellbrook but strips fitter and is capable of better.
